name: Fire Bolt
description: A focused bolt of fiery energy that streaks toward the target, leaving a trail of embers and heat.

metadata.reference: Fire Bolt concept sheet (projectile): cast 0-0.3 (ember orb gathers sparks), launch 0.3-0.54 (short streak), mid flight 0.54-1.6 (full ribbons), approach 1.6-2.3, impact 2.3-3.0 (radial sparks, flame petals, flash).
metadata.analysis: Molten cracked rock core 0.6 m wrapped in a white-hot flame sheath; flame ribbons and torn flipbook tongues stream 2-3 core lengths back and slightly up; embers scatter behind as streaks; a dark brown-grey smoke trail lingers with glowing embers inside.
